map.通过回答睡眠时长、入睡时间、夜间觉醒次数与日间状态等问题，综合评估睡眠质量并给出: By answering questions on sleep duration, time to fall asleep, night awakenings and daytime state, it assesses sleep quality comprehensively and gives improvement suggestions, helping users understand sleep habits and spot potential sleep disorder risks.

: Input: total sleep 7 hours (other sub-items at defaults).
Scoring: sleep duration 20 + falling asleep 10 + night awakenings 10 + depth 15 + daytime 15 = 70 points, rated 'good'.
Conclusion: with 7 hours of sleep and normal scores on every dimension the result is about 70, in the healthy range; if duration is <6 h or night awakenings are frequent, the score drops markedly and a risk note is given.
